item.title: Nous Research Fine-Tunes Qwen Model to Cut State Propaganda Rate Below 1%
item.description:
Nous Research supervised fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on 53 million tokens to produce Arete-27B, cutting the rate of state-propaganda responses from 22% to under 1% while preserving general capabilities. The team argues this shows political bias in Chinese open-weight models is only a superficial layer, and has released the weights, test set, and training data under Apache 2.0.

原文标题：Nous Research 微调 Qwen 模型 将政治宣传率从 22% 降至 1% 以下

Why it matters：以可复现的微调实验量化“对齐层”可剥离性，对开源模型治理与安全研究具有直接参考价值。

item.title: METR Report Finds Anthropic Using AI to Accelerate AI R&D, Doubling Model Progress Rate
item.description:
AI safety research organization METR published a report after an 11-week investigation inside Anthropic, finding the company is using AI to build more powerful AI, with model capabilities improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago and little sign of slowing. The findings have alarmed researchers about the risks of automated AI R&D, with METR's leadership urging society to brace for very rapid change.

原文标题：METR 报告：Anthropic 用 AI 加速 AI 研发，模型迭代速度翻倍

Why it matters：这是首份由独立安全机构对前沿实验室 AI 自我加速研发的实地评估，直接触及 AI 递归自我改进这一核心议题。

item.title: Discord Rewrites Client in Rust, Beating Electron on Cold Start and RAM
item.description:
Discord's co-founder and CTO posted a side-by-side demo showing the new Rust-based client loading its friends list from a cold start on Windows 11 while the existing Electron app was still on its loading screen. The new client used about 290MB of RAM with two accounts signed in, far below the multi-gigabyte footprint Electron builds can reach, offering concrete evidence for migrating desktop apps off Electron to native Rust stacks.

原文标题：Discord 用 Rust 重写客户端 冷启动与内存占用大幅优于 Electron

item.title: Google AI Detects Hypertension via Smartwatch Without a Cuff
item.description:
Google Research has introduced a neural network that flags signs of hypertension using only the pulse and motion sensors built into ordinary smartwatches, with no cuff calibration required. Trained via self-supervised learning on nearly 500,000 hours of sensor data, the model matched traditional cuffs in a 196-person study across five US sites. The method is now folded into Google Health's blood pressure trends feature but remains a research project, not a diagnosis.

原文标题：Google AI 用普通智能手表无袖带检测高血压

Why it matters：这是可穿戴传感器与自监督学习结合的重要健康 AI 进展，且已进入真实产品功能，值得关注。

item.title: Apple Unveils HALO Humanoid Robot System With 91% Success Rate in Unmapped Environments
item.description:
Apple's research team published an arXiv paper detailing HALO, a humanoid robot autonomy stack that layers a VLM task orchestrator, a DiT motion generator, and a reinforcement-learning tracker, deployed on a Unitree G1 with an onboard Mac mini for inference. Across 360 single-task trials in six previously unmapped real environments, HALO averaged a 91% success rate, though long-horizon composite tasks fell to 70% and the hardest combination to 50%. The team also open-sourced the data generation, training, and deployment code.

原文标题：苹果发布人形机器人 HALO 系统 未建图环境平均成功率 91%

Why it matters：苹果首次系统披露人形机器人端到端自主控制方案并开源全链路代码，91% 未建图成功率与分层架构对具身智能研究者有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Builds Pando Git Backend and Moves to Acquire Pierre as AI Coding Strains Code Hosting
item.description:
AI coding tools are multiplying pushes and automated jobs, and GitHub's repeated outages have exposed the limits of conventional code hosting. OpenAI has disclosed its internal Git backend Pando, reporting a nearly 80% drop in median push latency, and plans to acquire code-hosting tool Pierre; Anthropic has moved its main repository onto a self-built system, and Cursor now lets developers store projects directly. Code hosting is shifting from general-purpose platforms to custom infrastructure built for AI workloads.

item.description:

Google says it is reviewing the claims and this week made AI tools off by default for K-12 accounts, though schools that re-enable Search must accept bundled AI features—a move Fairplay calls forcing AI on schools.

item.title: Court Orders Insurer to Pay 46,000 Yuan After Firing Employee Over AI Tool Use
item.description:
A Beijing court ruled that an insurer unlawfully fired a legal staffer for uploading work data to a third-party AI platform, since internal rules never banned such tools, set no AI-specific compliance policy and offered no related training. The company must reinstate her and pay over 46,000 yuan in lost wages and bonus differences; an appeal was rejected. The case offers a rare judicial reference for corporate AI-use compliance and labor-law boundaries in China.

原文标题：员工用第三方 AI 办公遭解雇 法院判公司赔偿 4.6 万

item.description:
